newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes slightly down.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes slightly down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Wednesday closed slightly up in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 617.56 from 616.75 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 556,140 dinars against 2.57 million dinars.
Banque de Tunisie was up 2.33 dinars to 81.8 dinars on trade boosted by the exchange of shares' subscription rights. BIAT bank up 1.77 dinar to 60.82 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT was down 1.48 dinar to 44.52 dinars. Banque du Sud down 0.93 dinar to 29.97 dinars. ($=0.96 dinar)
